reader.requirement: After the last statement of a program whose paragraph is not under the control of another statement of that program there is no next executable statement: in a CALLed program an implicit EXIT PROGRAM returns to the caller (GRL2.5), in a main program flow is undefined (the compiler ends the run unit), while a last paragraph reached under PERFORM control returns to the PERFORM; this holds for separately compiled and contained (nested) programs.

edition-consulted.switches: dispatchState.SegmentEntry (set by the 1985 segmentation machinery when a program has independent segments) wraps the dispatch loop in a segment save/restore; it is construct-driven, not an edition test, and does not alter the fall-off/implicit-return arm
ConstructRegistry goback-bare-2002 refuses a written GOBACK at --std 85 (COBOL0880); the implicit return itself is the same ProgramReturn signal at every edition

reader.edition-search: grep of DispatchEmitter.cs for CobolVersion/EditionContext/Std found none; the only switches are SegmentEntry and DebugActive, both set from bound constructs (DispatchEmitter.cs lines 46, 59)
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the text differs (1985 calls the called-program case an implicit EXIT PROGRAM and leaves a main program undefined; 2023 calls it an implicit GOBACK) but the required observable behaviour is the same and the compiler emits one arm
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses exercise a main program's fall-off out of PERFORM/SORT ranges; a called program's and a contained program's fall-off (the GRL2.5 implicit EXIT PROGRAM), a program with no Procedure Division, and a repeated CALL in last-used state are not exercised at 85

reader.notes: The dispatcher bounds the activation's top-level call at the last element paragraph (LastElementPc) so a main or called program's fall-off returns to the activation entry, and a nested range that a GO TO left throws ProgramReturn past the last paragraph; the activation catches ProgramReturn and returns to a caller, which is the 1985 implicit EXIT PROGRAM. No edition arm exists or is needed.
